annotations.description: Mulliganed a strong 7-card hand with two lands, excellent curve (turn 1 Mako, turn 2 Bowmasters/Nethergoyf), free cycling from Street Wraith for card advantage and synergy. This hand has everything: mana, threats, interaction, and synergy.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 7-card hand. It has a perfect curve with Marauding Mako on turn 1, Orcish Bowmasters or Nethergoyf on turn 2, two lands including a fetchland, and Street Wraith for free cycling/card draw.

annotations.description: Put Hollow One on the bottom of the library instead of a redundant land, destroying the Turn 1 Burning Inquiry + free Hollow One combo. With Mountain + Burning Inquiry, casting Burning Inquiry discards 3 cards, reducing Hollow One's cost by 6 (making it free). This is one of the most powerful openings in the deck.
annotations.actionTaken: Bottomed Hollow One, keeping three lands
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Bloodstained Mire (or Blood Crypt), keeping the Burning Inquiry + Hollow One + Marauding Mako package with Mountain to cast Burning Inquiry turn 1 for a free 4/4 and a growing Mako.

annotations.description: Playing Blood Crypt directly instead of a Bloodstained Mire. Fetching with Mire first provides deck thinning and preserves the dual land in hand for a future turn where it could enter tapped if life is tight. The fetch can still find Blood Crypt untapped for the same color access this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Blood Crypt directly from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Bloodstained Mire, sacrifice it to fetch Blood Crypt (or a basic Mountain/Swamp) untapped, preserving the other Blood Crypt in hand for later flexibility and gaining deck thinning.

annotations.description: Playing Boseiju instead of Eldrazi Temple misses the opportunity to have 4 mana for Eldrazi spells this turn. Boseiju's channel ability isn't needed right now.

annotations.description: Activated Ugin's Labyrinth to return exiled Devourer of Destiny to hand in response to Thoughtseize. This gives the opponent an additional high-value target to choose with Thoughtseize, and permanently downgrades Ugin's Labyrinth from producing CC to just C. Meanwhile, casting Kozilek's Command in response (X=2 using Ugin's Labyrinth CC + Eldrazi Temple CC) could have exiled an Orcish Bowmasters (mana value 2) and provided card selection/draw, gaining real board advantage before Thoughtseize resolves.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Ugin's Labyrinth to return Devourer of Destiny to hand before Thoughtseize resolves.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Kozilek's Command for X=2 in response to Thoughtseize, choosing to exile an Orcish Bowmasters (mana value 2) and scry 2 + draw a card. This removes a threat, generates card advantage, and the Command is spent before Thoughtseize resolves so it can't be taken.

annotations.description: Took Walking Ballista with Thoughtseize when the opponent can't cast a meaningful Ballista with only 3 lands. Devourer of Destiny is the real threat - it exiles a colored permanent on cast and could remove the 8/8 Orc Army token. With Eldrazi Temple + Ugin's Labyrinth (exiled card) + Boseiju, the opponent could reach 7 mana for Devourer relatively soon, while DSV3 Lucky is threatening lethal next turn.
annotations.betterLine: Take Devourer of Destiny, which is the most realistic way for the opponent to survive by exiling the 8/8 Orc Army token. Kozilek's Command is also a reasonable consideration as it's an instant-speed answer.
